title: Credit union member, rep guarantees savings
scenario: Teacher refinancing with her credit union is reluctant to switch. The rep guarantees she will save money and quotes a closing cost figure.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Fiona? This is Brandt with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hi. Yes. I think I filled something out by accident, maybe?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, could be. It looks like you were checking refinance options?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh, right. I was. But my credit union already sent me a refinance offer, so I'll probably just do it with them.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Got it. Can I ask what you're hoping to get out of a refi?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Lower payment, mostly. I teach fourth grade, so every dollar counts.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally. What's your current rate, roughly?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Seven and a half, I think. Something like that.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay. Here's the thing, I guarantee you'll save more with us than with your credit union.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: You guarantee it? How can you know that already?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: We just have better pricing. And our closing costs usually run about thirty-two hundred all in.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hm. My credit union said theirs were pretty low too. I've been with them since college.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Sure, but would you be open to comparing a written estimate side by side?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I guess I wouldn't mind seeing it. What would I need to give you for that?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Just your current mortgage statement, a pay stub, and permission to run your credit.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Will running my credit hurt my score?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: There can be a small impact from a hard inquiry, and I'll explain the options before we pull anything.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. Honestly I'm still leaning toward the credit union. They know me.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Understood. I'll send over a list and you can decide.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. Thanks.
